{{Top}}
[[File:GrAdmUniform-SWI66.jpg|thumb|280px|Imperial Grand Admirals Thrawn and Miltin Takel in their Grand Admiral uniforms]]
{{Quote|He was wearing a white uniform. No other Imperial officers wore anything like that. And the contact I was with specifically called him a Grand Admiral.|Han Solo|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
The '''Grand Admiral's uniform''' was the official uniform worn originally by the thirteen [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]] personally chosen by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Similar in cut to the standard [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|Imperial uniform]], it was distinguished by being stark white in color as opposed to the usual olive-gray. Other distinctions included a unique [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]], and gold epaulets. Owing to its distinctive appearance, a number of Grand Admirals relied on only the plain white uniform without other insignia to identify themselves.

Many other [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] individuals began wearing the uniform as a sign of its power, despite not officially being promoted to the rank of Grand Admiral. Most notable were [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]], who wore a customized blood red uniform with a Grand Admiral's rank plaque when she ruled [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage's]] death; [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] during his [[Hunt for Zsinj|war]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]; and even Thrawn himself, who was seen wearing a similar uniform prior to his official promotion (at the very least since he held the rank of [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]]).
